verdicts.reason: A breaks the original's centred composition. The headline sits off-centre, to the right, and wraps badly, leaving 'sunshine.' alone on the second line. The CTA is pushed hard left on a different axis from the headline, and the LIMITED badge drifts to the right of the button as a separate oversized fragment, so nothing shares an edge. B keeps the centred headline with a balanced two-line break and keeps the original's badge-plus-CTA grouping. Its flaws: the headline is crammed near the top edge while a dead band of space sits below the button, and the badge-plus-button cluster is slightly off the headline's centre axis, the same off-centre placement as the original.
